ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Matter delivery, In progress and later stages need Start date and Target end date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Opening", 1, "Cleared to start", 2, "In progress", 3, "Awaiting client", 4, "Final billing", 5, "Closed", 6, 0) >= 3, OR(ISBLANK(Start_date__c), ISBLANK(Target_end_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Start date and Target end date before moving to In progress.
